Title: Daily order limit value can be changed and saved
Steps:
open the app
go to "/apps/order-scheduler-limit-sales-dev/app/limits"
check "Daily Order Limit"
fill css=input[type=number] with "2"
click "Save Changes"
Teardown:
go to "/apps/order-scheduler-limit-sales-dev/app/limits"
fill css=input[type=number] with "1"
click "Save Changes"
